Metadata.title: vibemovo
Metadata.homeTitle: vibemovo – AI image and video generator
Metadata.description: Turn a prompt into an image and an image into a video. vibemovo makes AI images, image-to-video clips and rap duo videos. New accounts start with free credits.

hero.title: Write a line. Watch it move.
hero.body: Describe a scene and get an image. Keep the one you like and turn it into a 5 or 10 second video.

1.title: Text to image
1.body: Write what you want to see. Pick one of five shapes, from square to 9:16 for phones.

2.title: Image to video
2.body: Upload a photo or use one you made. Describe the motion and choose 5 or 10 seconds.

3.title: Rap duo
3.body: Two photos and two names become a 15-second rap video. Each person raps a line written for them.

steps.title: From words to motion in three steps

1.title: Write a prompt
1.body: Describe the subject, the light and the mood. Plain words work.

2.title: Pick the best image
2.body: Make a few and keep the one that fits. A failed image gives its credit back.

3.title: Make it move
3.body: Turn the image into a video. We tell you when it's ready, so you can leave the page.

1.title: What can I make?
1.body: Images from a text prompt, videos from an image, and 15-second rap duo videos from two photos.

2.title: How do credits work?
2.body: Images and seconds of video each cost credits. New accounts start with free credits. Buy a pack or subscribe on the Credits & billing page. Credits never expire, and a failed generation gives them back.

3.title: How long does a video take?
3.body: Usually a few minutes. You can close the page: you get a notification when the video is ready.

4.title: Do I need a password?
4.body: No. We email you a sign-in link, or you can use your Google account.

5.title: How do I contact support?
5.body: Email <email></email>. We reply within 3 business days.

cta.title: Your first scene is one prompt away.
cta.body: Sign in with your email and try it on free credits.

RapLanding.title: AI Rap Video Generator from Photos
RapLanding.description: Turn two photos and two names into a 15-second rap video. vibemovo writes the lyrics and makes the beat, the vocals and the lip sync.

hero.title: AI rap video generator from photos
hero.body: Upload two photos and type two names. You get a 15-second video of both people rapping, with lines written for their names, a beat and vocals.

result.alt: Four frames from a 15-second AI rap video: two people in an orange studio with a hanging microphone. The woman on the left raps first, then the man on the right.
result.caption: Four frames from a real result. The left person raps first, then the right person takes the mic.

steps.title: From two photos to one rap video

1.title: Upload two photos
1.body: One person in each photo, facing the camera, in good light. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {size} MB each.

2.title: Type two names
2.body: Up to {max} characters each. Each person gets one line, written for their name.

3.title: Generate
3.body: One video costs {credits} credits. It is usually ready in a few minutes, and you can play or download it.

1.title: Lyrics for their names
1.body: The two lines rhyme and use the two names. They are in the language of the page: English or Chinese.

2.title: Beat and vocals included
2.body: You don't upload a song. The video comes with its own beat, both voices and lip movement.

3.title: Same faces, same sides
3.body: Each face and outfit stays the same for the whole clip. The left photo stays on the left.

1.title: How much does a rap video cost?
1.body: {credits} credits for one 15-second video. New accounts get {signup} free credits, which is not enough for a rap video. Buy credits on the <pricing>pricing page</pricing>.

2.title: What if a video fails?
2.body: You get the credits back. Try again with the same photos or different ones.

3.title: How long does it take?
3.body: Usually a few minutes. You can close the page: you get a notification when the video is ready.

4.title: Which languages are the lyrics in?
4.body: The language of the page: English on the English site, Chinese on the Chinese site.

cta.title: Make your first rap video
cta.body: Sign in with an email link or your Google account. No password.
